_notes.variant_specific: Variant-specific phase numbering and names are declared in each variant's docs/phase-definitions.md and docs/<variant>.context.md workflow table (ADR-0096); this canonical list is the workspace-root schema and is not a per-variant naming rule
_notes.variant_agents: Variant-specific agent tiers are declared in each variant agent's frontmatter tier block (templates/<variant>/agents/*.md); variant.json carries only the agent roster (name/file pairs), not tiers
_notes.root_allowlist_divergence: This L1 copy intentionally diverges from the workspace-root docs/workspace-schema.json: CONSTITUTION.md is absent from rootAllowlist.files here because no scaffolded project carries that file (CONSTITUTION.md §7.5 non-propagation), while the L0 copy must keep the entry for its own stray-root check — intentional per spec 2026-10-28-l0-only-governance-doc-cleanup (DEC-20261028-05); the pair is hand-maintained (ADR-0069), each copy is validated against its own repo.

i18n.description: Internationalization policy. locale_codes defines all language codes recognized as valid translation zones. Files inside <lang-code>/ or locales/<lang-code>/ directories, and *_<lang-code> suffix files (e.g. README_ko.md, tracked by hash-sync), are exempt from the English-only documentation rule. en is the source language, not a translation-zone target.
i18n.note: audit.ts and validate-md-language.ts must read locale_codes from this file — do NOT hardcode language codes in scripts.

country_scoped_assets.description: Skills, scripts, env keys, and variant asset directories whose function is specific to one country/region because they access that country's data systems (NOT language-based). Pruned from generated projects/L3 drafts at scaffold time unless the project's target country matches. Registry-only SSOT — do not mark skills in SKILL.md frontmatter. Never register language skills (translate etc.) here.

variant_scoped_skills.description: Skills whose function is exclusive to ONE variant. Registry-only SSOT (owner-curated — heuristics cannot distinguish these from genuinely common skills). If such a skill is found in templates/common/skills/ it is a promotion mistake: validate-templates FAILs and upgrade-project prunes it from projects whose variant does not own it (skills/ + .claude/.gemini/.agents mirrors). sound-synth (co-game) leaked this way on 2026-08-06 into 10 of 11 projects.

rootAllowlist.description: Whitelist of files and directories permitted in the workspace root. Anything not in these lists triggers a stray-artifact audit failure.

variant_extensions.description: Optional top-level keys allowed in variant.json beyond the base contract. Validated by validate-templates.ts.

_shared._note: Documentation-only cross-reference. $ref values here are NOT machine-validated JSON Schema refs. For standard JSON Schema, use $defs pattern instead.

agent_manifest.description: Agent roster metadata and optional pipeline configuration. Available in all variants.
agent_manifest.notes: pipeline_order: omit or use [] for variants with parallel/free-form agent dispatch. retry_policy: declares on_fail routing and max_retries per agent. optional[]: agents that can be skipped by PM.

country_config.description: Country/jurisdiction profile configuration. supported[] lists ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 or well-known region codes (EU, ASEAN; pattern ^[A-Z]{2,4}$) for profiles shipped under profiles_dir. default MUST be null (region-neutral) — a non-null default region-locks the variant and triggers a validator warning.
country_config.notes: profiles_dir is 'docs/countries' in all current variants. Each supported code must have <profiles_dir>/<CODE>.md with frontmatter code/name/status/last_verified. Profiles are advisory jurisdiction knowledge (loaded at engagement start), never auto-executed. Country != language — language policy remains i18n.locale_codes.

designLint.description: Design-lint gate config (audit.ts checkDesignLint): token SSOT compliance scan roots for UI source; allowlist entries exempt documented literals. A scaffolded project may declare the same block in variant.json to override this one per project (order: variant.json > workspace-schema; enabled boolean required, scanRoots/allowlist optional string arrays - U-20261028-014).

routeAudit.description: Write-route audit tripwire config (scripts/route-audit-scan.ts, T-20261029-005, generalized from co-newbiz PR #742 FR-SEC-07): every route.ts exporting POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE must reach an auditTokenPatterns match within its local import graph (depth-3) or carry an allowlist entry with a >= 10-char reason. auditTokenPatterns are regex sources (here: the documented co-newbiz defaults verbatim — a host project with different audit-token names declares its own); allowlist keys are root-relative POSIX route.ts paths; optional sharedInfra (string[]) lists basenames whose audit tokens never count as route-level audit. Not yet wired into audit.ts/dev-sync — wiring follows host adoption. A present-but-malformed block is a hard error; a missing block falls back to the script's co-newbiz defaults.

platform_surfaces.description: Per-platform capability and adapter SSOT for agent-persona mirrors (design 2026-10-28-platform-agent-mirror, DEC-20261028-06). `agents.supported: true` rows MUST have a generator adapter in scripts/sync-agent-mirrors.ts PLATFORM_AGENT_ADAPTERS; the coverage guard fails loud on a mismatch (registry row without adapter, adapter without a supported row). Every `supported: false` row carries an `evidence` string so the matrix cannot silently rot back to oral tradition. Skills/commands/hooks rows are descriptive today (machinery: sync-skills.ts); agents rows are enforced. The platform set is pinned by validate-model-registry.ts PLATFORMS; directory-name constants stay in scripts/lib/platforms.ts — this registry owns capabilities and formats, not paths.
